sections.title: What is this app?
sections.body:
PeekABooCode is a small, privacy-first tool that does four things:

  • Clean — paste a link or scan a QR/barcode, strip trackers, check for threats, and make new codes.
  • Test — check your camera, microphone, and speaker before a call.
  • Help — this page. Everything you need in one place.
  • Settings — custom app mapping, custom tracking parameters, import/export.

Nothing is uploaded. No accounts. No analytics. Only three network requests, all opt-in.
sections.shortAnswer: A privacy-first tool to clean links, scan codes, check threats, and test your camera. Nothing leaves your browser unless you say so.
sections.shortAnswerSi: Meka privacy-first tool ekak. Link clean karanna, codes scan karanna, threats check karanna, camera test karanna. Oyage browser eken bahata yanne nathuwa oya kiwwoth witharai.

sections.title: Link Cleaner
sections.body:
Paste a link or scan a code. We strip tracking parameters (like utm_source, fbclid, igshid) and show you the source app. Then we check the link for phishing signals and let you copy or make a QR/barcode.

You can also drop a QR or barcode image anywhere in the panel, or use your camera to scan.
sections.shortAnswer: Paste a link in the Clean tab and click Clean. We strip trackers and show where it's from.
sections.shortAnswerSi: Clean tab eke link eka paste karala Clean click karanna. Api trackers ain karala eka kohenda kiyala penawa.

sections.title: QR vs Barcode
sections.body:
Both hold data, but they're used differently.

  • QR codes are 2D squares. They hold up to about 3 KB — links, text, Wi-Fi details, contact cards. Readable at any angle, tolerant of damage.
  • Barcodes are 1D lines. They hold short numbers — 8 to 14 digits typically. Used for product labels, retail, inventory, shipping.

When to use QR: sharing links, restaurant menus, Wi-Fi passwords, contact cards, payments, event tickets.

When to use barcodes: product packaging (EAN-13, UPC-A), shipping cartons (ITF-14), library books (Codabar), internal inventory (Code 128).

In this app: QR is used for links. Barcodes are used for product codes.
sections.shortAnswer: QR holds links and text. Barcodes hold short numbers. Use QR for links, barcodes for products.
sections.shortAnswerSi: QR eken links danna puluwan. Barcode eken numbers witharai. Links walata QR, product walata barcode.

sections.title: Phishing & spam protection
sections.body:
Every cleaned link gets a verdict:

  • ✅ Clean — no suspicious patterns found.
  • 🟡 Minor concerns — a few things worth a second look.
  • 🔴 Suspicious link — high risk. Be careful.
  • ⚪ Unknown — not analyzed, or online check unavailable.

Checks include: unusual TLDs, brand-name typosquatting, Punycode/homograph tricks, IP addresses, shorteners, login words on HTTP links, redirect parameters, and more.

The online check button sends the domain to a free security API. It's opt-in — nothing is sent until you click and confirm. If the API is blocked or times out, we say so honestly instead of guessing.
sections.shortAnswer: Every cleaned link gets a color verdict. Green means clean, yellow means caution, red means risky. The online check is optional and tells you the truth either way.
sections.shortAnswerSi: Hamama cleaned link ekata colour verdict ekak enawa. Green = clean, yellow = cautious, red = risky. Online check eka optional, ekata giyama honda naraka kiyanawa.

sections.title: Pre-call A/V test
sections.body:
Test your camera, microphone, and speaker before a call.

  • Live camera preview
  • Mic level meter — speak and it moves
  • Speaker test tone
  • Device pickers for camera, mic, and speaker
  • Optional 3-second record and playback — stays in your browser

Nothing is recorded, saved, or uploaded. Stop releases all devices immediately.
sections.shortAnswer: Go to the Test tab and press Start. We use your camera and mic only for the test — nothing is saved.
sections.shortAnswerSi: Test tab ekata giyama Start press karanna. Camera mic use karanawa test ekata witharai — save wenne naha.

sections.title: Short link expansion
sections.body:
Shorteners like bit.ly, t.co, and tinyurl.com hide the real destination. We flag them and offer an Expand button.

Expanding tries to follow the redirect from your browser. Some shorteners block this (CORS), so we may not be able to show you the destination. In that case we offer an Open link button so you can see for yourself.

This is opt-in — nothing is fetched until you click Expand.
sections.shortAnswer: Short links hide the destination. Click Expand to try to reveal it — it's opt-in and may fail if the shortener blocks browsers.
sections.shortAnswerSi: Short links eka real destination eka hanga gannawa. Expand click karanna try karanna — opt-in, shortener eka block karanawa nam fail wenawa.

sections.title: Settings
sections.body:
All stored locally in your browser.

  • Custom app mapping — add a domain and the name we should show for it.
  • Custom tracking parameters — extra params to strip, plain words or regex.
  • Import / Export — JSON, CSV, XLS, or Print-to-PDF.
  • Reset — clear custom entries. Built-in defaults always stay.
sections.shortAnswer: Settings are in the Settings tab. Custom apps, custom params, import/export, and resets. Everything's local.
sections.shortAnswerSi: Settings tab eke. Custom apps, custom params, import/export, resets. Okkoma local.

sections.title: Privacy
sections.body:
Nothing leaves your browser unless you ask it to.

Network requests (all opt-in):

  • Short link expansion — only when you click Expand.
  • Online threat check — only when you click Yes, check.
  • Search this code — only when you click Search.

Library loads on first use:

  • ZXing (scanner) — from a CDN the first time you scan.
  • SheetJS (XLS) — from a CDN the first time you use XLS.
  • qrcodejs, JsBarcode — served from this site (assets/lib/).

No accounts, no analytics, no cookies, no logs.
sections.shortAnswer: Nothing leaves your browser unless you click Expand, Check online, or Search. No accounts, no analytics, no logs.
sections.shortAnswerSi: Oyage browser eken bahata yanne naha, Expand, Check online, or Search click kaloth witharai. Accounts, analytics, logs naha.

sections.title: Help bot
sections.body:
I'm the help bot. I run entirely in your browser.

  • Ask me a question in English or Singlish.
  • Tap 👍 if my answer helps, 👎 if it doesn't.
  • If I get it wrong, I'll ask what you meant and learn for next time.
  • If I don't know something, I'll offer to add it as a new question.

Everything I learn stays on your device. You can reset me from Settings.
sections.shortAnswer: I'm the local help bot. Ask in English or Singlish. Feedback makes me better. Reset me from Settings.
sections.shortAnswerSi: Mama local help bot ekak. English or Singlish walin ahanna. Feedback eken mama honda wenawa. Settings eken reset karanna.

sections.title: Singlish glossary
sections.body:
Sinhala words written in English letters, commonly used in this app and its bot.

  • oni — need / want
  • karanna — do / make
  • puluwanda — can you?
  • mokada — what
  • kohomada — how
  • koheda — where
  • eka — the / it
  • oyage — your
  • mata — to me
  • ain — remove
  • hadanna — make / fix
  • balanna — see / look
  • therenne — understand
  • hari — okay / correct

Ask the bot in Singlish — it understands common variants like oney, one, karana, and karanna.
sections.shortAnswer: Singlish is Sinhala written in English letters. The bot understands common words like karanna, oni, puluwanda. Full glossary on the Help page.
sections.shortAnswerSi: Singlish kiyanne Sinhala wachana English letters walin liyanawa. Bot ekata karanna, oni, puluwanda wage wachana therum gannawa. Full list Help page eke.
